definitions.short: Baanah , the name of four Israelites
definitions.full: H1196. Baanah בַּעֲנָה proper name, masculine (? id. ) — 1 a Benjamite, one of the murderers of Ishbosheth 2Sam 4:2 , 5 , 6 , 9 . 2 father of one of David's heroes 2Sam 23:29 = 1Chr 11:30 . 3 head of a family of returning exiles Ezra 2:2 = Neh 7:7 ; perhaps also = בַּעֲנָא 3:4 . 4 a chief of the people Neh 10:28 .
definitions.rootNote: from a derivative of 6031 with prepositional prefix; in affliction
